operations.name: get-document-ocr-public-key
operations.summary: Issue a public key for credit card or ID card OCR

operations.name: analyze-credit-card
operations.summary: Analyze an encrypted credit card image

params.name: X-Key-Version
params.description: Version of the issued public key

params.name: Symmetric-Key
params.description: 32-byte random symmetric key encrypted with the public key (RSA/ECB/PKCS1Padding)

fields.name: image
fields.description: Image file pre-encrypted with the symmetric key (AES-256/CBC/PKCS7Padding, IV = first 16 key bytes)

operations.name: analyze-id-card
operations.summary: Analyze an encrypted ID card image (returns Request-Key for authenticity check)

params.name: X-Key-Version
params.description: Version of the issued public key

params.name: Symmetric-Key
params.description: 32-byte random symmetric key encrypted with the public key (RSA/ECB/PKCS1Padding)

fields.name: image
fields.description: Image file pre-encrypted with the symmetric key (AES-256/CBC/PKCS7Padding, IV = first 16 key bytes)

operations.name: verify-id-card-authenticity
operations.summary: Check ID card authenticity with the Request-Key from analyze-id-card

params.name: X-Key-Version
params.description: Version of the issued public key

params.name: Symmetric-Key
params.description: 32-byte random symmetric key encrypted with the public key (RSA/ECB/PKCS1Padding)

params.name: Request-Key
params.description: Request-Key from ID card analysis (valid 1 hour, single use)

fields.name: name
fields.description: Name (AES-256/CBC encrypted with the symmetric key)

fields.name: residentNumber
fields.description: Resident number, 13 digits for resident, 7 for driver (AES-256/CBC encrypted with the symmetric key)

fields.name: issueDate
fields.description: Issue date YYYYMMDD, required for resident (AES-256/CBC encrypted with the symmetric key)

fields.name: driverLicenseNumber
fields.description: 12-digit license number, required for driver (AES-256/CBC encrypted with the symmetric key)

fields.name: serialNum
fields.description: 5-6 digit serial number, required for driver (AES-256/CBC encrypted with the symmetric key)
